```esql
FROM k8s
| EVAL day = DATE_TRUNC(1 day, @timestamp)
| STATS c = COUNT(*) BY b = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 hour), day
| RENAME b AS hour
| EVAL month = DATE_TRUNC(1 month, hour), ninety = DATE_TRUNC(90 minutes, hour)
| DESCRIBE
| KEEP name, role, interval, time_zone
```
